data.one_liner: Tool to rename package identifiers across all platform files in a Flutter project
data.what_it_does: Updates package names, app names, bundle identifiers, and related fields in Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, Web, and Windows files. It scans and replaces 37 fields across 19 files to make a project production‑ready.
use_when: You need to change the package name or bundle identifier for a new release
You want to rename the app name or organization across all platforms
You are migrating a project to a new namespace or company
avoid_when: You only need to change a single file manually
You are working on a non‑Flutter project
strengths: Configurable via a single YAML file or pubspec section
weaknesses: Only a dev dependency, not usable at runtime
May not cover custom or non‑standard project templates
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml and run `dart run package_rename` (or with --flavour or --path). No build_runner or permissions needed.
data.minimal_example:
```yaml
# pubspec.yaml

dev_dependencies:
  package_rename: ^1.10.1

# package_rename_config:
#   android:
#     app_name: "My App"
#     package_name: "com.example.myapp"
#   ios:
#     app_name: "My App"
#     bundle_name: "My App"
#     package_name: "com.example.myapp"
```
```bash
dart run package_rename
```
